_comment: The licensing register for news/event sources. Every row here has an actual reviewed terms_reviewed_at date and a terms_url a human can re-check. CLAUDE.md non-negotiable: do not add a source without this review — 'zero unreviewed sources' is Phase 1's Definition of Done. See GeoPulse/docs/planning/2026-09-20-initial-plan.md §10 for the full research this is drawn from.

_not_yet_seeded: Major-publisher RSS (Reuters, AP, BBC, etc.) is explicitly deferred, not merely
unresearched: Reuters discontinued public RSS ~2020, AP's public feeds are
unreliable, and most mainstream RSS terms of use exclude commercial reuse (see
planning doc §10, §1.4). Any publisher added here in a later phase needs its own
dated terms_reviewed_at citation, same as the rows above — do not bulk-add a
publisher list without that review per source.
